apollo.line: A NASA photograph taken at Kennedy Space Center, Florida, on July 16, 1969. The Apollo 11 rocket is lifting off, carrying the first astronauts who would walk on the Moon. NASA. Free to use.

train.line: A wide photograph (a panorama) taken in Key West on January 22, 1912, the day the first train crossed the Florida Keys to reach the island. Taken by Harris Co. Library of Congress. Free to use.
